title: Cloud Control API coverage
intro: Every Cloud Control API operation the emulator advertises, and what Emuplane does
with it. The service is JSON 1.1 under the `cloudcontrol` credential scope with the
`CloudApiService` target prefix, and has no console action. The same eight
operations manage every resource type: a resource is keyed by `(TypeName,
Identifier)`, and mutations complete synchronously, so `CancelResourceRequest` is
exercised as the documented conflict against a terminal request.
